title: The Ass and the Mule
summary: An ass and a mule were carrying heavy loads. The ass faltered and begged the mule to take a small sack, but the mule refused....
full_text:
An ass and a mule were carrying heavy loads. The ass faltered and begged the mule to take a small sack, but the mule refused.

The ass dropped dead upon the road. The driver transferred the entire load and the flayed skin of the ass onto the mule, who wept under the double weight.
moral: Share your comrade’s burden lest his death leave you with the entire load.
